entry.title: dotnet/sdk - Issues & Pull Requests - 2025-07-24
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • Fix BlazorWasm dotnet-watch tests #49928
  • Microsoft.NET.Publish.Tests.PublishItemsOutputGroupOutputsTests.RunPublishItemsOutputGroupOutputsTest fails for single-file win-x86 publishing #49926
  • Some razor tests don't work due to System.Memory mismatch #49925
  • Revise dotnet test behavior if test app targets `netX.0;netX.0-windows` #49924
    10.0.1xx
  • Test AddProjectToSolutionPostActionFindSlnxFileAtOutputPath doesn't work on Linux #49923
  • `dotnet package add System.Memory@4.6.3` says `Build succeeded` #49921

Closed

  • .NET 10 Shebang Issue: `#!/usr/bin/dotnet` intercepts script arguments as dotnet commands #49892
  • Dotnet new "Add project to solution" postAction can not find slnx files #48878

PullRequests

Created

  • Analysis: -d option deprecation for dotnet tool install --create-manifest-if-needed already resolved #49930
  • Add a details section for the dotnet info output #49929
  • Fix dotnet/sdk#49921 by making the dgspec inner build silent #49927
    Area-NuGet, Area-CLI, cli-ux

Merged

  • [main] Source code updates from dotnet/dotnet #49740
    Area-CodeFlow, Area-VMR
  • Update version branding to rc1 #49919
    Area-CodeFlow
  • [release/10.0.1xx-preview7] Show deprecation warning for OpenAPI analyzers #49918
    Servicing-approved
  • Fix recognizing `dotnet ./file.cs` with special arguments #49909
    Area-run-file
  • Fix dotnet new "Add project to solution" postAction to find .slnx files #49541

Updated

  • Implementing dotnet pack with nuspec files #49813
  • Implement support for changing project and package references #49611
    Area-AspNetCore
  • Send Ctrl+C to launched process before killing it on Windows #49847
    Area-AspNetCore
  • Add support for flat launch settings #49769
    Area-run-file
  • [release/10.0.1xx-preview7] Source code updates from dotnet/dotnet #49905
  • Update MSTest version from 3.9.0 to 3.9.3 in test templates #49857
  • Cleanup DOTNET_ROOT logic for dotnet run #49913
